name: SplitButton
description: A primary action fused to a chevron that opens an animated menu of secondary actions. The chevron flips, the menu scales in from its anchored corner with staggered items, flips above the button when there is no room below, and can promote the chosen action into the primary slot.
a11yNotes: Follows the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern: the chevron has aria-label, aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is role="menu" with role="menuitem" buttons. Enter/Space or ArrowDown opens and focuses the first item, ArrowUp the last; inside the menu ArrowUp/Down wrap, Home/End jump, printable characters type-ahead, Enter/Space activate, Escape closes and returns focus to the chevron, Tab closes, and outside clicks close. Under prefers-reduced-motion the menu only fades.

propsApi.name: actions
propsApi.default: ['Deploy to preview', 'Deploy without cache', 'Schedule deploy…', 'Roll back to previous']
propsApi.description: Secondary actions listed in the menu (must be unique).

propsApi.name: onClick
propsApi.description: Called when the primary part is pressed, with its current label.

propsApi.name: onAction
propsApi.description: Called when a menu action is chosen.

propsApi.name: rememberLast
propsApi.description: Swap the chosen action into the primary slot (the old primary takes its place in the menu).

propsApi.name: onOpenChange
propsApi.description: Called when the menu requests to open or close.

propsApi.name: menuLabel
propsApi.description: Accessible label of the chevron trigger and the menu.

propsApi.name: side
propsApi.description: Preferred menu side; flips when it does not fit in the viewport.

propsApi.name: align
propsApi.description: Align the menu with the left or right edge of the button.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Brand color for the default variant.
